newsitem.title: USA: Anicom CEO backs '97 $0.29-$0.30 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Anicom CEO backs '97 $0.29-$0.30 EPS view.

text.p: Anicom Inc supports the analysts' consensus that the company will post 1997 per-share earnings in a range of $0.29 to $0.30, chief executive officer Scott Anixter told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"We're comfortable that we can achieve those goals," Anixter said, adding he also backed the street projection of $170 million in sales for the company this year.

Earlier Tuesday, the Rosemont, Ill.-based seller and distributor of multimedia wiring products posted higher fourth-quarter and year-end results. Quarterly earnings rose to $855,000, or $0.06 a share, from $259,000 or $0.03 a share.

As a result of acquisitions in 1996, it incurred $823,000 of one-time non-recurring post acquisition integration costs. The company also recognized a gain on the sale of assembly plant lines of about $878,000.
Sales jumped in the quarter to $39.6 million from $9.4 million a year earlier.
For the full year, per-share earnings advanced to $2.6 million, or $0.20 a share, from $764,000. or $0.14 a share, and sales rose to $116 million from $29.4 million.
"Eventually, we plan to grow to a $1 billion (sales) company, but I won't put a time frame on that," Anixter said.

In the past 18 months, Amicom acquired seven companies, adding an aggregate $105 million in revenues, at a total cost of $28 million in cash, stock and notes plus assumption of about $7 million in debt.
Anicom seeks to buy more wire and cable distribution companies.
"I hope to be able to complete some acquisitions before the end of the first half of 1997," Anixter said.
